data.narrative:
Figure AI, a Series C AI & Software company founded by Brett Adcock, is evaluated against a universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private peers including Skild AI, Crusoe Energy, Wayve, and Physical Intelligence, spanning Series B through Series D stages.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the company's last post-money valuation of $39.0B, applies a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, yielding $66.3B. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Skild AI ($14.0B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), Wayve ($8.6B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B)—produces a median of $8.6B, with a range of $3.2B to $14.0B.

The triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $7.3B to $76.2B, with a median of $37.5B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression implies substantial upside from current post-money, while peer-median suggests current valuation significantly exceeds the median comparable. Key drivers of this variance include capital efficiency relative to peers, revenue or deployment metrics not captured in the comp set, and stage-specific risk premia. Further diligence on company-specific traction metrics and peer-set relevance would be required to narrow the range.
